title: OutreachDetailResponse
description: Response containing outreach details including emails, replies, and timeline

tenantId.description: Tenant that owns this outreach record

workflowId.description: Credentialing workflow (practitioner or facility) this outreach was sent for

outreachType.description: Outreach category this record was created for

reasons.description: List of outreach reasons with IDs and labels. Note: This field changed from List<String> to List<OutreachReasonWithLabel> to provide enriched reason information with labels.

active.description: Whether this outreach is still open/awaiting a response

attemptsCount.description: Number of outreach emails sent for this record

lastAttemptedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent outreach attempt

workflowStatus.description: Status of the referenced credentialing workflow at the time of this response

createdBy.description: User ID that created this outreach record

createdByName.description: Display name of the user that created this outreach record

createdAt.description: Timestamp this outreach record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp this outreach record was last updated

emails.description: Full email thread for this outreach, each with its replies and attachments

timeline.description: Chronological activity entries recording status transitions and key events

name.description: Original file name of the attachment

reasonId.description: Outreach reason this attachment answers (provider portal submissions only)

fromAddress.description: Sender email address(es) of the reply

toAddresses.description: Recipient email addresses of the reply

ccAddresses.description: CC email addresses of the reply

direction.description: Whether this reply was sent by CertifyOS or received from a recipient

deliveryStatus.description: Delivery status for this reply, when applicable

updatedAt.description: Timestamp this reply was last updated

attachments.description: Files attached to this reply; each id is usable with the attachment download endpoint

direction.description: Whether this email was sent by CertifyOS or received from a recipient

deliveryStatus.description: Latest SendGrid delivery status for this email

engagementData.description: Raw engagement event data reported by SendGrid for this email

dispatched.description: Whether this email was successfully dispatched via SendGrid

sendgridId.description: SendGrid message ID for this email, null if it was never dispatched

statusCode.description: HTTP status code returned by SendGrid for this email's send attempt

createdAt.description: Timestamp this email record was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp this email record was last updated

attachments.description: Files attached to this email; each id is usable with the attachment download endpoint

OutreachReasonWithLabel.description: Outreach reason with ID and label

id.description: Unique identifier for the outreach reason

label.description: Display label for the outreach reason

id.description: ID of the underlying outreach or email record this timeline entry describes

title.description: Human-readable label for this timeline entry

type.description: Kind of record this entry describes

status.description: Status label at this point in the timeline
